text: Nina Sayers, a young dancer at the New York City Ballet who lives with her overprotective mother, wins the dual lead in Swan Lake: the fragile White Swan, which suits her, and the dark, sensual Black Swan, which does not. As her director urges her to let go, a newcomer named Lily, [her uninhibited near-double|threat|impostors and doubles], seems ready to [take her place|wants|taking someone's place]. Scratch marks appear on Nina's back, the hallucinations multiply, and she comes to believe [she is turning into the Black Swan|rules|the body changes].
